title: Basque-Style Cheesy Galette
description: A savory, French-Basque inspired dish featuring a dense, flaky crust topped with a blend of cheeses.
instructions: Roll out the ultra-dense pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch (23 cm) tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a bowl, mix together the cheddar, French cheddar, and Basque cheese.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the cheese, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the crust with a little bit of water and then sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
